alt: Architectural rendering of seven large stacked boulder-shaped structures rising from Rotterdam's riverbank, rendered as smooth rounded lumps
story: Dutch firm MVRDV won a €240M competition to build Rotterdam's next landmark with 'Rotterdam Rocks!' — seven stacked lumpy boulders on the Maas riverfront — and readers immediately called it 'a bad acid trip' and 'something Shrek would throw up.'
why_funny: An architectural rendering of what is objectively a pile of cartoon boulders, presented to the public as a serious world wonder.
